usage: 多明尼加 is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Dominican Republic.
When talking about nationality, 多明尼加 can describe someone or something from the Dominican Republic.
多明尼加 can be used in travel or geography contexts to specify location or origin.
It is often shortened to 多明 (do1 ming4) in casual speech, but more commonly 多明尼加 is used formally.
When asking or saying where someone is from, 多明尼加 can be the answer to questions about country of origin.
